comment: Caches quad reads and existence checks of ACL documents across requests to avoid re-reading and
re-parsing them on every authorization decision. It sits directly below the MonitoringStore and
invalidates synchronously from the ChangeMap of every write, so read-after-write and notification-driven
authorization always see fresh data. INVARIANT: all writes MUST flow through this wrapper; any store that
mutates ACL data while bypassing it would leave the cache stale (the BackendKeyValueStorage path only
stores locks under /.internal/ and is ACL-irrelevant). KILL SWITCH: set options_ttl to 0 for pure
passthrough; removing the import of this file and pointing MonitoringStore back at ResourceStore_BinarySlice
